caption: The carved limestone Ned Hayes Park nameplate, set into the brick gable of the corner house. A nice piece of stonework that anchors the entrance into the estate (May 2026)

Looking up the road into Ned Hayes Park, with the new bungalows on the left and a young tree-lined verge on the right. The estate is one of the newer parts of the village and the planting is still bedding in (May 2026)

Young Silver Birch and a mixed shrub layer along the back boundary at Ned Hayes Park. The Birches will throw a beautiful dappled canopy once they mature, and the shrub layer underneath gives bird cover and pollinator value while it fills in (May 2026)
